verdict.rationale: The only documented sign-in path, the franchise-tax/annual-report portal, is keyless. It asks for a Business Entity File Number plus an image CAPTCHA, which an authorized human can complete remotely with no biometric liveness check, in-person visit, or mailed PIN. However, it is not credential MFA at all: there is no account, credential, or second factor, and the authentication for the Document Filing Service used for formation is undocumented. Missing for 10: any documented credential-based login with MFA, authentication details for the Document Filing and Certificate Request Service, and hands-on confirmation of the sign-in flow.
